task_definition: Select one pose-valid extra frame that maximizes novel observed cells inside nine frozen body/path capsules; UNKNOWN remains unknown.

results.finding: TUM evaluation parent-macro was 8.1167 versus passive 8.0417 and generic 8.4917; zero strict-win parents.
Leave-one-FIT-parent-out pairwise ridge beat both macro baselines but produced strict wins in only 3 of 6 FIT parents; Bonn target reads remained zero.
The frozen far_unknown_parallax scorer beat passive on 171 Bonn references but lost to generic, 18.0474 versus 19.2037.
No frozen hybrid candidate passed both TUM-six-parent and Bonn gates.

Exactly one of 96 frozen candidates passed both sources: translation_unit + 0.8 visible_unknown_unit + 0.05 rotation_unit. It scored 14.4139 versus generic 14.0222 on 12 TUM parents and 19.2229 versus generic 19.2037 on 24 Bonn parents.

On 19 references from four parent-disjoint task-outcome-blind TUM parents, the frozen policy beat generic and passive in macro mean, 11.6375 versus 11.25 and 8.9375, but only 2 parents had a strict win against the frozen minimum of 3. Two other parents had no oracle strict-win opportunity.
On 40 references from 17 ARKitScenes parents, 9 parents had oracle strict-win opportunity but the policy covered only 2; macro 16.3363 was below generic 16.4490 while oracle remained 25.0863.

claim_ceiling: R13 task-evidence oracle headroom remains positive, but no source-time scorer is confirmed transferable. This is Development and confirmation-attempt evidence, not collision correctness, Android integration, product, default-App, or safety evidence.

unique_successor.objective: Train only on now-consumed TUM, Bonn, and ARKitScenes task-evidence outcomes; require leave-one-source-family-out superiority over passive and generic before locking a new task-outcome-blind source.
